review_type: A10 saved-screenshot visual verification within integrated R2 runtime work
selection_rule: Only listed finished, passed attempts; latest passed complete, access, budget-layout and disconnect phases selected. Failed attempts remain in browser-checkpoints.json and are not visual passes. No browser, runtime, database, test or product-code actions by this reviewer.
result: HC-R2-W02 was identified in the original 390px allowance dialog and resolved in the targeted corrected-build confirmation. Before/after screenshots remain listed. No unresolved actionable visual findings among the 22 actually viewed images.

findings.status: resolved in targeted A10 confirmation within existing integrated R2
findings.description: The Cancel button extends beyond the left viewport edge beside the long confirmation label; the button and label are partly clipped at 390px.
findings.impact: The dialog dismiss action is not fully visible within the narrow viewport. A page-level horizontal-overflow flag was false and did not detect this absolutely positioned dialog-footer overflow.
findings.required_confirmation: Use the corrected production Web build and inspect a settled 390px dialog; verify both button bounding boxes are within the viewport and both actions are reachable.

resolution.description: The shorter Increase allowances label allows both buttons to fit. Actual saved image inspected; checkpoint records both enabled with all bounds inside 390x844.
resolution.interaction_limit: The layout phase inspected enabled buttons and geometry at 390px, then switched to desktop and clicked Cancel. It asserted unchanged revision/allowances and cancelled the unconfirmed proposal. It did not reconfirm an allowance increase under the new label.

limitations: These are static viewport screenshots, not a fresh interaction or accessibility test. Reachability below the viewport is not independently proved here.
The desktop confirmation appears to be captured during its transition; the corresponding 390px confirmation is visibly settled and fully readable.
Closed native select controls truncate long date/state/UUID option text at 390px. Selected capture state and identity are repeated in the report; opened-option behavior was not inspected.
Table-local horizontal scrolling was not independently exercised by this reviewer. Root reports separate verification that scrolling exposes the Review controls.
No 390px Person-review screenshot was listed for the selected complete phase; this artifact claims desktop Person review only.

The corrected allowance-dialog phase verifies both enabled controls and viewport bounds at 390px; Cancel was clicked after restoring desktop width. No second allowance increase was performed solely for the label/layout correction.
